questions.q: If the shipment ______ by Friday, we will contact the supplier and ask for a refund. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: 主要子句是 will contact，第一類：if 子句講未來也用現在式 doesn't arrive，will 只放主要子句。

questions.q: If we ______ a larger warehouse, we could keep more stock, but we don't. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: but we don't 表示跟現在的事實相反，第二類：if 子句用過去式 had。will、would 都不放在 if 子句。

questions.q: If the team had checked the figures last week, the report ______ so many errors. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: if 子句是 had checked（與過去事實相反），第三類：主要子句用 would have＋過去分詞 wouldn't have contained。

questions.q: ______ you need to reschedule your appointment, please call our office during business hours. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: 後面是原形 need、主要子句是祈使句，第一類的倒裝：Should you need（＝If you need）。Had 後面要過去分詞，Were 後面要 to 不定詞。

questions.q: Had we known about the delay, we ______ the client much earlier. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: Had we known 是第三類的倒裝（＝If we had known），主要子句用 would have informed。

questions.q: If Ms. Lee hadn't moved to the sales department last year, she ______ our team leader now. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: 過去的條件（hadn't moved last year）、現在的結果（now）：混合條件句，主要子句用 would＋原形 would be。

questions.q: I wish I ______ the contract more carefully before I signed it. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: 後悔過去的事（簽約前沒仔細看），wish＋過去完成式 had read。

questions.q: Our prices haven't changed in five years. It's time we ______ our pricing strategy. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: It's time＋主詞＋過去式，講的是現在早該做的事：It's time we reviewed。

questions.q: The company picnic will be held in the park ______ it rains heavily. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: 「除非下大雨，否則野餐照常在公園辦」：unless。provided that、as long as 會變成「只要下大雨才辦」，in case 是「以防萬一」，意思都不通。

questions.q: If I ______ you, I would ask the contractor for a written quote first. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: 我不可能是你，跟現在的事實相反，給建議的固定說法 If I were you，主要子句用 would ask。
